operationInterrupted.title: An earlier Nexus operation was interrupted
operationInterrupted.summary: It stopped before verification. Nothing was replayed automatically.
evidenceStale.title: Evidence is out of date
evidenceStale.summary: Readiness cannot be confirmed from stale evidence.
evidenceStale.observed: Last scan is older than the freshness window
platformUnsupported.title: Not supported on this platform
platformUnsupported.summary: This Agent cannot be managed here.
notInstalled.title: Installation required
notInstalled.summary: The Agent cannot work until a supported installation exists.
notInstalled.observed: No installation in PATH or known locations
notExecutable.title: Installation is not executable
notExecutable.summary: The Agent cannot start from this file.
versionUnknown.title: Installed version is unknown
versionUnknown.summary: Readiness stays unknown until the version is established.
duplicateInstallations.title: Several installations found
duplicateInstallations.summary: The one earliest in PATH runs; updates to another copy may not take effect.
runtimeMissing.title: Required runtime missing
runtimeTooOld.title: Runtime is too old
configMalformed.title: Configuration file cannot be parsed
configMalformed.summary: The Agent may refuse to start or ignore your settings. Nexus will not edit a malformed file.
configUnreadable.title: Configuration could not be read
configUnreadable.summary: Health cannot evaluate settings it cannot read.
configUnreadable.expected: A readable file owned by you
configAmbiguous.title: Two global configuration files
configAmbiguous.summary: OpenCode merges both; which value wins cannot be verified, so Nexus will not edit either.
modelIncompatible.title: Assigned model cannot be used
modelIncompatible.summary: This Agent cannot route to the chosen Provider without handing it a secret.
modelIncompatible.expected: A model from a Provider this Agent supports
assignmentPending.title: Model assignment not applied yet
assignmentPending.summary: Your choice is saved in Nexus but the Agent configuration has not changed.
assignmentPending.observed: Agent still uses its previous setting
assignmentDrift.title: Configuration changed after Nexus applied it
assignmentDrift.summary: Someone or something edited the model setting. Nexus did not overwrite it.
modelOverridden.title: A higher-priority source overrides the model
modelOverridden.summary: The configuration holds {{applied}}, but the Agent uses {{effective}}.
environmentOverride.title: Environment variables change Agent behaviour
mcpCommandMissing.title: MCP server command not found
mcpCommandMissing.summary: {{servers}} will fail to start when the Agent loads it.
mcpCommandMissing.expected: An installed command, or the server disabled
skillInvalid.title: Skill is missing required metadata
checkFailed.title: A check did not pass
manual.refresh: Scan again to refresh the evidence.
manual.platform: Use a supported platform for this Agent.
manual.installOfficial: Install using the Agent's official instructions, then scan again. Nexus will adopt it without changes.
manual.reinstall: Reinstall the Agent with its original installer.
manual.versionProbe: Run the Agent once in a terminal, then scan again.
manual.duplicates: Remove the copy you do not use with the installer that created it.
manual.installRuntime: Install or update the runtime with your usual tool, then scan again. Nexus never replaces toolchains.
manual.fixConfig: Fix the file in an editor (no Nexus backup of a known-good version exists yet).
manual.permissions: Check the file owner and permissions.
manual.mergeConfig: Merge the two files into one, then scan again.
manual.chooseCompatible: Choose a model from a Provider this Agent supports.
manual.unsetOverride: Remove or change the overriding variable where it is set.
manual.fixMcpCommand: Install the server command or remove the entry in the Agent.
manual.fixSkill: Add a name and description to SKILL.md.
manual.reviewInterrupted: Review the result and run a new plan if needed.
